title: Fix Drag Pieces In Design Implementation
description:
Fix dragPiecesInDesign across all languages (JS, Go, C#, Rust) to match spec:
1. Fixed pieces must check center AND plane (not just center)
2. Descendant filtering must check against ALL selected pieces (not just fixed pieces)
Add Go drag test. Update docs.
summary: Removed didPanDragRef.current = false from handlePointerEnd in SemioDiagram. The flag was being reset before handleSvgClick could read it, causing click events that some browsers fire after pointer-capture drags to incorrectly clear the selection. handleSvgClick already owned the reset; handlePointerDown resets it at each drag start.
